meta.name: developer-growth-analysis
meta.description: Analyzes your recent Claude Code chat history to identify coding patterns, development gaps, and areas for improvement, curates relevant learning resources from HackerNews, and automatically sends a personalized growth report to your Slack DMs.

copy.tagline: 分析编码习惯并推送个性化成长报告到 Slack
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从聊天记录中发现编程短板并获取学习资源
copy.tagline_en: Analyze coding patterns and send personalized growth reports to Slack
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to identify coding gaps and get learning resources from chat history

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你最近 24-48 小时的聊天记录，找出你的编码模式、技能短板和改进方向，然后生成一份个性化成长报告，并自动发送到你的 Slack 私信。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 分析你的近期编码工作，或指定时间范围（如“今天”）时触发。

say.text: 分析我最近的编码工作，找出需要改进的地方。
say.note: Claude 会读取聊天记录并生成报告。

say.text: 分析我今天的工作，给出学习资源推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your recent 24-48 hours of chat history to identify coding patterns, skill gaps, and improvement areas, then generates a personalized growth report and sends it to your Slack DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze your recent coding work or specify a time period (e.g., 'today').

say_en.text: Analyze my recent coding work and find areas for improvement.
say_en.note: Claude reads chat history and generates a report.

say_en.text: Analyze my work today and suggest learning resources.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on today's work and includes HackerNews articles.
